items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: in later years I lived in an apartment building out in Los Angeles where Tatum lived.

ctx.x: did because they both were very proud guys, you know. They both could play, you know. So, I imagine they did. I know Tatum -- anywhere a piano player was, he'd go, you know. He was like a lion, man, a roaring lion. This was his cup of tea, you know. He would do it all -- I don't care where a piano player was, he would go. He'd find him, you know. And he never stopped playing.

I lived in a -- in later years I lived in an apartment building out in Los Angeles where Tatum lived. And he had a piano up there. And he'd play all day. When he got up -- I could tell you when he got up. He'd -- before he -- he'd jam all night after he worked, and he'd go to bed. But when he got up, he would -- I could tell when he got up. He would start playing.
Where was this? Where abouts in Los Angeles?
